summary: BI-4CB2EF76. Migration 20260901040000_add_workroom_participant_assignments adds WorkCapsuleParticipant as the canonical Workroom roster. Explicit policy-named assignments are distinguishable from legacy WorkItem assignee backfill. Derived coordinator membership is not written. Additive; existing WorkCapsule and WorkItem rows keep their current columns. Backfill is idempotent ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING against live-shaped WorkItem.evidence and PrincipalAlias rows.

fields.name: principalId
fields.reason: FK to the existing Principal row. Creates no second identity home; the roster points at the canonical principal.
fields.provenance: Resolved from workroomPolicy.participants.principalRef, invite principalRef, or PrincipalAlias for a legacy WorkItem assignee.

fields.name: roles
fields.reason: Closed collaboration-role set for this room (accountable, coordinator, contributor, specialist, approver, reviewer, observer). Operational membership, not a data-subject attribute.
fields.provenance: Named in the room policy or invite; legacy backfill copies only accountable/contributor from WorkItem assignment and never invents coordinator.

fields.name: assignmentSource
fields.reason: Provenance of the membership row (explicit vs legacy). Operational metadata used to refuse autonomous drive on a derived or legacy-only Process Overseer.
fields.provenance: Set to explicit for policy/invite writes; legacy for WorkItem assignee backfill.

fields.name: enteredReason
fields.reason: Short operational explanation of why the principal is in the room.
fields.provenance: Copied from the policy snapshot or the invite writer.

fields.name: currentWorkSummary
fields.reason: Optional current-work label for the room surface. Not a data-subject attribute.
fields.provenance: Copied from the policy snapshot or WorkItem.title for legacy assignees.

fields.name: lifecycle
fields.reason: Platform record-lifecycle convention. Marks whether this membership row is currently active.
fields.provenance: Defaults to active; archived when membership is withdrawn.
